title: Bloomberg: Labcorp Outlines Long-Term Growth Strategy during 2026 Investor Day

body_markdown:
Bloomberg highlighted Labcorp’s long-term growth strategy, emphasizing the company’s leadership in specialty testing and personalized medicine. Ahead of its investor day, Labcorp projected compound annual revenue growth of 5% to 8% through 2029 and adjusted earnings per share growth of 8.5% to 11.5%, while reaffirming its 2026 financial guidance.


In an interview with Bloomberg, Labcorp president and CEO Adam Schechter said growth is being fueled by expanding demand for specialty testing in oncology, neurology, autoimmune disease and women’s health, areas that are growing faster than the broader diagnostics market. He noted that advanced diagnostic testing can improve patient outcomes and help lower healthcare costs by enabling more personalized treatment decisions.


The article also highlighted Labcorp’s plans to drive growth through a strong pipeline of acquisitions, including the recent acquisition of MLM Medical Labs, as well as new hospital laboratory partnerships. Bloomberg further noted the continued momentum of Labcorp’s direct-to-consumer testing business, which offers more than 140 health tests and is delivering strong double-digit growth as consumers become more proactive in managing their health.


**Read the full**[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-10/labcorp-unveils-long-term-outlook-driven-by-specialty-testing) **article to learn more about Labcorp’s long-term outlook and growth strategy.**
